'''Don Brittian''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 28th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Players Choice]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw21_3">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Players Choice], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001219114400/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
